rubric_items.reason: Every changed branch of RefList and doctorsLinkLabel is exercised: count > 0 link for both kinds, count 0 plain text, Inactive rows, plural and singular labels, plus row actions and add forms unchanged.
Assertions check href, aria-label, visible text, request URLs and filter values. The fetch mock returns the same doctors for any filter, so 'lists only those 3 doctors' is not observably checked.
Count 0, count 1, Inactive entries, a failed department list and clearing the filter are covered. Inactive-entry journeys and the specialization 'Any status' list content are checked only partly.
Vitest, jsdom and Testing Library in web/src/__tests__, names start with the HMS-29 REQ id, fetch stubbed with vi.stubGlobal as in DoctorsPage.test.tsx. Only the test file changed.
The 13 tests stated match the verifier test log, and coverage is not claimed because the verifier skipped it (exit 78).
